cooldown and max attempts persist across four fresh processes
new claim clears previous batch attempt
all products including idle products preflight before any upload
all products dedup coverage and backend eligibility preflight before any upload

limitations: Synthetic client workflow tests do not replace live merchant dedup verification or backend database integration tests.
